mvp_description: AI-powered earthwork estimation and site operations bidding tool for construction companies
summary: The site-ops-pro MVP is an EarthFlow Estimator tool designed for construction and earthwork companies to quickly generate bid proposals for site operations. The visual analysis identified that the original branding attempted to combine 'Severino & Koski Construction' - two separate entities. Research confirmed J Severino Construction Inc. and Koski Construction Co. are distinct businesses in Ashtabula. The tool is well-designed with an orange construction-industry color scheme and clean UI components including sliders and input fields for project specifications.

leads.name: Brobst Earthworks, LTD
leads.fit_rationale: Local Ashtabula company specializing in excavation, demolition, and land projects. Actively provides free estimates and works with insurance companies. Small, growing business that would benefit from streamlined estimation tools. Strong online reviews indicate customer-focused approach aligned with modern digital tools.

leads.name: J Severino Construction Inc.
leads.fit_rationale: Family-owned business with 50+ employees specializing in site development, earthwork, industrial construction, and underground utilities. Already identified in original MVP concept. Perfect fit for earthwork estimation tool due to focus on site development and earthwork projects throughout Ohio.

leads.name: Koski Construction Co.
leads.fit_rationale: Heavy highway contractor and asphalt producer serving Ashtabula since 1998 (listed in Blue Book). Distinct company from Severino Construction. Specializes in road construction and sewer projects requiring accurate earthwork calculations. Established business with Chamber of Commerce membership.
leads.source: Brave Search + Greater Ashtabula Chamber of Commerce

leads.name: Mark Haynes Construction
leads.fit_rationale: 40+ years in business specializing in mass excavation, Lake Erie erosion control, and watershed conservation. Extensive earthwork experience with Armor Rock revetments and shoreline projects. Large-scale projects require sophisticated estimation tools for mass excavation quantities.
leads.source: Brave Search - Lake Erie erosion control specialist

leads.name: Corrado Construction Company
leads.fit_rationale: Third-generation family business specializing in earthmoving, excavation, utility work, demolition, and brownfields development. Traditional site work services align perfectly with earthwork estimation tool. Experience with restoration and development projects requires accurate bidding.
leads.source: Brave Search - Northeast Ohio excavating contractors

key_issues: Original branding incorrectly combined two separate companies (Severino & Koski) into one entity
No clear target company identified for white-label deployment
Generic 'EarthFlow Estimator' name lacks local market connection
Partner branding hardcoded into UI based on false premise
opportunities: J Severino Construction and Koski Construction are both real, separate entities - potential dual-target strategy
Orange accent color appropriate for construction industry (energy, caution, visibility)
Clean UI with professional sliders and input components ready for branding overlay
Strong local construction market in Ashtabula County with multiple potential targets

site_improvements.recommendation: Replace with dynamic company selector or generic branding until specific client is secured
Select one primary target from leads (recommend Brobst Earthworks or J Severino Construction) and customize demo
Add testimonials, project portfolio samples, or case studies from target market

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_scheme: Orange accent on neutral background - highly appropriate for construction industry, conveying energy, caution, and industrial strength
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography: Clean, legible sans-serif with good font weight differentiation between labels and input values
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.component_quality: Professional sliders, buttons, and input fields - appears to use modern UI library (likely Tailwind/Shadcn)
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout: Well-balanced interface with clear visual hierarchy - project inputs at top, results/bid generation at bottom
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.polish: High level of polish for MVP - no visible clipping or layout bugs
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.trust_elements: Generate Bid Proposal CTA prominent, project details clearly displayed

whitelabel_potential.reasoning: The EarthFlow Estimator has excellent white-label potential for construction and earthwork companies. The modular UI components can easily be rebranded with company colors, logos, and specific service offerings. The underlying estimation logic is industry-standard (cut/fill calculations, material quantities) applicable across earthwork contractors.
whitelabel_potential.recommended_approach: Create white-label package targeting small-to-medium excavation contractors in Northeast Ohio, with customization for: company logo/colors, service area definition, equipment fleet integration, and material cost database for local suppliers

action_next: Contact Brobst Earthworks (highest priority - local Ashtabula, small business, actively seeking growth)
Reach out to J Severino Construction (established player, already referenced in original concept)
Schedule demo with Koski Construction (heavy highway focus adds different use case)
Correct MVP branding to remove 'Severino & Koski' combined entity reference
Prepare customized demo for top 2 leads with their actual project types
